allowed_case_material: canonical ProblemSpecV1 document and its candidate-only hash
content-locked generic fixture plugin manifest needed to compile the document
public bounds, origins, variable scales and semantic relation scales
frozen public local options and hard budgets
forbidden_case_material: latent-group or representation IDs and links
Gold configurations, targets, intervals or tolerances
expected decisions, analytic truth or branch truth
candidate.semantic_target_exception: ProblemSpecV1.target is required public problem semantics and is not a Gold answer. It may appear only inside the canonical problem document.
candidate.checksum_boundary: Candidate case, artifact and manifest hashes contain candidate-tree bytes only.

assessor.process_access: opened by a separate assessor process only after candidate raw output is sealed
allowed_case_material: primary or Safety16 role and expected_invariant flag
Gold configurations, distinct targets and fixed tolerances
inverse representation map and analytic or branch truth needed for assessment
forbidden_use: candidate calibration, routing, local steps or termination
mutating candidate inputs or sealed raw output
selecting starts, thresholds, families or a replacement run

generator_private.process_access: one-shot materializer and audit only; never candidate or formal assessor input

runtime_layers.document_loader: May read one candidate ProblemSpec and its content locks only to construct the oracle.
runtime_layers.compiler: May read typed graph, plugin contracts and public numeric metadata; it receives no assessor or generator-private tree.
runtime_layers.solver_and_calibrator: Receive only the callable compiled C0 oracle, physical bounds/origin/scale, persisted calibration points, one start and frozen options. They never receive problem, plugin, primitive, case, family, group or representation IDs.
runtime_layers.candidate_output: Contains opaque_case_key, variant, start index, endpoint, charged execution trace, semantic/canonical replay and calibration audit only; it contains no Gold match.
runtime_layers.assessor: Joins sealed candidate output to assessor truth by opaque_case_key and start index after verifying both manifests and the output seal.

mandatory_dsl_path: RFC 8785 canonical encoder and protocol validator
forbidden_shortcuts: family-, primitive-, problem- or representation-based routing
formal_order: The candidate process receives only the candidate-tree path. It seals and closes its raw output before a new process may receive the assessor-tree path. Root and generator-private manifests are never candidate arguments.
